description: This file defines the FileNode class, a custom node for a rich-text editor built using Lexical. It manages the serialization, deserialization, DOM conversion, and rendering of file embedding within the editor, supporting features like zoom level adjustment and unique identification of file nodes.

classes.name: FileNode
classes.description: A Lexical decorator block node representing a file attachment, supporting serialization, DOM conversion, and custom rendering.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type string identifier for this node class.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of this node instance.

methods.name: importJSON
methods.description: Creates a FileNode instance from a serialized JSON object.

methods.name: exportJSON
methods.description: Exports this node to a serialized JSON object including file identification and zoom level.

methods.name: importDOM
methods.description: Provides DOM conversion rules for parsing HTML elements into FileNode instances.

methods.name: exportDOM
methods.description: Exports this node content into an HTML span element with a data attribute for reconstruction.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes a FileNode with specified id, format, key, and zoom level.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the file item.

methods.name: getTextContent
methods.description: Provides a textual representation of the file node, used for debugging or accessibility.

methods.name: setZoomLevel
methods.description: Updates the zoom level of the file node.

methods.name: decorate
methods.description: Renders the file component visually within the editor as a React component.
